name: Fleyta v sklyanomu futlyari
source:
Desperate for money, Iya takes on a dubious business to save her agency from collapse. What is a person capable of at a critical moment?

[Translated from [url=https://panihannax.itch.io/fluteinaglasscase]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于缺钱，伊亚接手了一项可疑的生意，以挽救她的机构免于崩溃。一个人在关键时刻能有什么能力？

[翻译自[url=https://panihannax.itch.io/fluteinaglasscase]itch.io[/url]]
